payload.body: loadLlmConfig reads .env.local relative to the process working directory, so a test that SPAWNS the CLI inherits the repo's real key even when POE_API_KEY is blanked in the child env. A draft of tests/ui/cli.test.ts did exactly that and spent 2232 real tokens against api.poe.com before it was caught. Any spawned-process test must pass --no-llm or point the env-file variable at a nonexistent path; blanking the key alone is not enough.
